original_target.title: The nonlinear Landau limit of weakly interacting particles

scope_comparison: Actual Winter1905.05021 Theorem1.1 starts from a non-Markovian equation obtained by truncating BBGKY and uses near-Maxwellian data and a specified interaction potential. It is not a derivation from all interactions of the stated Newtonian particle hierarchy. Linear tagged-particle and kinetic grazing-collision limits do not settle this nonlinear full-particle limit.
